about: Campgrounds, cabins and lodges INSIDE Kentucky POTA parks for kpc-campgrounds.html. Park names, counties, GPS and the POTA/KFF/SOTA lists come live from kpc-ky-data.json. Campground facts checked against the official pages on the date in each entry (checked). Places outside the parks are not listed; people can leave reviews of them through the form (see kpc-campground-notes.json, type "other").

parks.note: 24 developed/semi-developed camping areas on the forest; the 12 most useful are listed. Others: Bell Farm, Little Lick horse camps; Boat Gunnel, Craigs Creek, Twin Knobs group camps; Claylick, Grove, White Oak boat-in; Indian Creek, Paragon, Table Rock, Trace Branch areas (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/danielboone/recreation/camping-cabins). Map links are the Forest Service 'Guide/Map' files on Box.
